about: What a recipe's material makes its working part weigh (D565: mass comes from the parts' shapes and materials and feeds D459's rule): the part's volume_m3 times its material's density. Read by the assembler (terra_items::assembly) and the part checker (tools/items/part.ts). A material here is one an item is made in today (items.ron's stone and iron tools); a new tier adds its line with its source.

iron.about: wrought or bloomery iron, the iron tools' heads

density_kg_m3.source: pure iron 7.874 g/cm^3 at 20 C (CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, physical constants of the elements), recalled; wrought iron's slag puts it 1 to 2% lower

stone.about: knapped flint or chert, the stone tools' heads

density_kg_m3.source: flint and chert 2.6 g/cm^3, a little under quartz's 2.65 (mineral handbooks' specific gravity of chalcedony), recalled
